statements.t: “We continue to advance our pulmonary hypertension strategy, with data from the Auxora Phase 1b proof-of-concept trial in PH and the CM5480 IND submission both anticipated in mid-2027,” said Rachel Leheny, Ph.D., Chief Executive Officer of CalciMedica.
We expect multiple meaningful catalysts over the next 12 months.”
The Company expects its cash, cash equivalents and short-term investments to fund its current operating plan into the second half of 2027.
Findings from the trial are also expected to inform the continued development of CM5480, the Company’s oral CRAC channel inhibitor for chronic dosing.
